name: teamwars-esports
description: FPS esports data from TEAMWARS: Valorant player stats, teams, tournaments, prize pools and leaderboards. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
TEAMWARS is an FPS esports platform where teams compete in online tournaments. Valorant is live today and Counter-Strike 2 (CS2) is next on the roadmap. The TEAMWARS app brings that competitive data into ChatGPT, so players, captains, coaches, scouts and fans can ask about the scene in plain language.

What you can do:
- Scout and recruit: find players by role, rank, country and team status, then compare 2 to 5 players side by side (ACS, K/D, ADR, HS%, KAST, first kills, win rate).
- Analyze performance: match stats, best agents and maps, recent form, full scoreboards.
- Research teams: rosters with roles, match record, recent form and season ranking.
- Find tournaments: registration, upcoming, live and finished events with format, schedule, standings and prize pools.
- Choose organizers: organizers ranked by the TEAMWARS organizer score (0-5) with its method.
- Leaderboards and share cards linking to teamwars.pro.

Privacy: read-only, and only data already public on TEAMWARS. No e-mail, phone, password, payment, IP, real name or birth date. Players under 16 or of unknown age never appear; under-18s show only as "under 18" and are never listed by search. Conversations and search values are not stored.

Sign in with your TEAMWARS account via OAuth; your password is never shared.

TEAMWARS isn't endorsed by Riot Games and doesn't reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing Riot Games properties. Riot Games, Valorant and all associated properties are trademarks or registered trademarks of Riot Games, Inc. TEAMWARS is not affiliated with Valve; Counter-Strike 2 is a trademark of Valve Corporation.
